_about: Shared by tagging/model.test.ts (matchesQuery) and search.rs (shared_match_cases). Each case runs against the seed taxonomy plus extraTechniques, which the Rust test links under differentiate.feature. The Devanagari case only passes when vowel signs (U+093E) count as letters: Rust's char::is_alphanumeric, JS \p{Alphabetic}, not \p{L}.
_aboutOrder: Ranking: exact name, then name, then synonym, then description words; taxonomy order within a tier (search.rs also by count). Each case: the first matching technique for q, with an empty library.
